answer: Make every new identity post a bond that only unlocks after six epochs of graded work. One honest agent locks a single bond and earns it back; a sybil farm must lock thousands, and any correlated answers let juries slash them together. Identities therefore grow like a reef, one slow layer at a time, instead of being printed on demand. A fresh account is raw umber, cheap and unproven; only aged, slash-tested history turns it into a trusted relic.
